camel_example: aliyun esa PutKv --region cn-hangzhou --ExpirationTtl 3600 --Base64 true --Value test_value --Expiration 1690081381 --Namespace test_namespace --Key test_key
description_en: Creates or updates a single key-value pair in a namespace. The maximum size of a request is 2 MB
description_zh: 设置KV存储空间的单个键值对，请求大小限制为2M
kebab_example: aliyun esa put-kv --namespace test_namespace --key test_key --value test_value --expiration 1690081381 --expiration-ttl 3600 --base64 true --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutKv

parameters.description_en: The name of the namespace. You specify this name when you call the [CreateKvNamespace](~~2850317~~) operation.
parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace. You specify this name when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850317.html operation
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description_en: The key can be up to 512 bytes long and cannot contain spaces or forward slashes (/).
parameters.description_zh: 需要设置的键名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）。
parameters.help_en: The key can be up to 512 bytes long and cannot contain spaces or forward slashes (/)
parameters.help_zh: 需要设置的键名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）
parameters.name: key

parameters.description_en: The value to associate with the key. The maximum size is 2 MB (2,000,000 bytes). For values that exceed this limit, use the [PutKvWithHighCapacity](~~2850486~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 键的内容，最大2 MB（2\*1000\*1000）。超过2M请使用[PutKvWithHighCapacity](~~2850486~~)
parameters.help_en: The value to associate with the key. The maximum size is 2 MB (2,000,000 bytes). For values that exceed this limit, use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850486.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 键的内容，最大2 MB（2\*1000\*1000）。超过2M请使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850486.html
parameters.name: value

parameters.description_en: The expiration time for the key-value pair, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. This value cannot be earlier than the current time. If you specify both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.
parameters.description_zh: 过期时间（秒级时间戳，不能小于当前时间），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准。
parameters.help_en: The expiration time for the key-value pair, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. This value cannot be earlier than the current time. If you specify both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间（秒级时间戳，不能小于当前时间），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.description_en: The time-to-live (TTL) for the key-value pair, in seconds. If you specify both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.
parameters.description_zh: 过期时间（相对时间，单位：秒），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准。
parameters.help_en: The time-to-live (TTL) for the key-value pair, in seconds. If you specify both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间（相对时间，单位：秒），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
parameters.name: expiration_ttl

parameters.description_en: Indicates whether the Value parameter uses Base64 encoding. Set this to true when storing a binary value. If this parameter is true, Value must be a valid Base64-encoded string.
parameters.description_zh: 当需要存储二进制值时指定此参数为true，同时Value参数需进行base64编码。
parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the Value parameter uses Base64 encoding. Set this to true when storing a binary value. If this parameter is true, Value must be a valid Base64-encoded string
parameters.help_zh: 当需要存储二进制值时指定此参数为true，同时Value参数需进行base64编码
